item.title: Time Immemorial turns 750: The Medieval law that froze history at 1189
item.description:
📝 Anything before that date is time immemorial. Explicitly why 3rd September 1189 was chosen as the barrier between that which we know and that which we don’t has itself been lost to time. So if you ever hear someone breezily stating that “it’s been like that since time immemorial”, you can pedantically point out that they mean prior to 3rd September 1189.
🔗 Read more: https://www.ianvisits.co.uk/articles/time-immemorial-turns-750-the-medieval-law-that-froze-history-at-1189-84893/
